title: Six for six.
subject: PNN: Six teams. One night. Zero arrests. A full report, with a route map and a can of Spam.
preheader: Underwear, cattle, treasure, a retirement party, a web, and a kiddie pool. Clueso has the timestamps. He does not have the suspects.

featuredCase.teaser: **The night ended in a kiddie pool.** Six houses earlier, it started with underwear. In between: cattle, treasure, a party nobody woke up for, and a web PNN predicted in its very first case. The last stop was the fire team. *The fire is out. The Spam has been replaced.*
featuredCase.hook: including the full route log, one stop per team

image.alt: A six-photo grid, one from each stop of the night: giant pink satin underwear reading Not Tonight on a papered porch planter; an inflatable alien in a cowboy hat riding an inflatable cow; an open black treasure chest marked PP full of foil coins in a pink net; a skeleton in a silver wig, a RETIRED tiara, and a sash; furry toy spiders caught in a giant pink web; and a glowing kiddie pool of crying pumpkins with a can of Spam on top.
image.caption: Supplied game photos, one per stop. Six teams, six themes, zero suspects in frame.

sections.kicker: SPECIAL REPORT / THE INSTITUTE FOR NOCTURNAL LOGISTICS
sections.heading:
Six teams. One night. Zero arrests.
(A peer-reviewed study of the Pink Sweep.)

runs.text: has completed its review of the night of
'the most efficient evening in the history of the Broomstick Challenge, and possibly of evenings.'
every other team in the game in a single night.
Six houses. Six themes. One route, in about two hours.
The Institute checked the rule book.
Rule 2 allows one prank per team.
The pink team used all six, in order, and was home before the Silver Bullets' alarm clocks.
once pranked three houses in a night, forgot to announce one, and told the game group
'It's like we're the only ones playing.'
The Institute can now confirm they were not.
The Institute also notes that the pink team
a panther on the door, a panther on the garage, a panther on the lawn, and paw prints for punctuation.

sections.heading: The numbers, such as they are

items.text: **Teams pranked, out of six available.** *Teams left over: none. The pink team checked twice.*
**Hours from the first scene photo to the last.** *About eighteen minutes a house, group portrait included.*
**Group portraits posed at the scene.** *Faces blurred by PNN: every one. Clueso: inconsolable.*
**Cows branded 'PP' on the Area 51 Bureau's lawn.** *Cows consulted: zero. Cows befuddled: also zero. They are inflatable.*
**Can of Spam delivered to the Pyro Posse.** *Spam the Posse ate that night: one, its own. Replacement: confirmed in writing.*
**Arrests.** *Wanted everywhere. Caught nowhere. Now with timestamps.*

runs.text: a team can prank six houses in one night
if it stays up past the Silver Bullets' bedtime.
It also helps to bring the toilet paper pre-signed.

sections.heading:
Six stops. Six themes.
(Read in order. Side effects vary by team.)

runs.text: Underwear for the underwear team: a monogrammed clothesline, a yard full of toilet paper, and giant satin briefs reading 'Not Tonight.' The homeowners drove in mid-prank and could barely park. They were hit briefly. The cleanup was briefer.

Four days after declaring a 'cosmic lockdown' on the pink team, the Bureau found two alien cowboys riding branded cattle on its lawn and alien beef jerky at its door. The aliens had a little too much fun with the cattle.

The Crew's lookout watched the pink team hoist a flag on its porch and leave a chest of real treasure. The Crew held its fire and called it 'top-tier entertainment.' The ship is, as the Crew once put it, ours.
A midnight retirement party: balloons, a banner, pink cupcakes, senior coupons, and a skeleton in a tiara. The guests of honor slept through it. The skeleton was the life of the party.
A giant pink web across the front walk, spiders caught in it, and a bottle of Black Web Spider Spray. Caught in their own web, exactly as PNN drew it in case one.
A kiddie pool of crying pumpkins, a can of Spam with a paw print, and a sign reading 'You've Been Purr-manently Extinguished!' The Posse didn't have enough flame left to spread.

sections.heading:
Every team takes home a trophy.
(Not the real trophy. The witches handle that one.)

runs.text: Yard spotless by morning. The Institute suspects a team with a lot of practice and something to hide.
A team built to explain the unexplained, staring at two cows in cowboy hats.
Best Review of Its Own Prank: The Crimson Crew.
'Top-tier entertainment.' Five stars, posted by the victim.
Slept through their own party. The coupons are good whenever they wake up.
Most Accurately Predicted: Black Webb Bandits.
PNN drew it in case one. The pink team built it in case sixteen.
Thanked the pink team for the Spam. The first thank-you note ever written by a fire.
Six counts of excellence. Accepted in absentia, because nobody can find them.
One cosmic lockdown. Last seen four days ago.
Two cows, branded PP, grazing at the Area 51 Bureau.
The owners know who they are. So does everyone else.
One Werewolf Management hotline, never used.
Never installed, either. Inquiries to a number that does not exist.
Security footage of the pink team mid-prank.
The Crimson Crew has it. The Crew is holding it, along with its fire.
One kiddie pool, lightly cried in.
Pumpkins included. Spam sold separately; ask the Pyro Posse.
No webs. No spiders. No problem. References available from the Black Webb Bandits.

sections.kicker: A NOTE FROM INSPECTOR CLUESO'S OFFICE
sections.heading:
I had them.
(I had all of them. In pink. On six lawns.)

runs.text: Inspector Clueso has spent sixteen cases hoping for evidence against the
On October 19, he got all of it at once:
paw prints, monograms, group portraits, a route log, and a can of Spam.
His own newsroom blurred the faces. The Crimson Crew kept the footage. The Silver Bullets were asleep. The aliens only smiled.
The masthead's 'Wanted everywhere, caught nowhere' was supposed to be marketing.
On October 19 it was an itinerary.
keep pranks clever, kind, and away from sleep and young children (rules 6 and 7). Photo or video proof goes to the game group by
which, Clueso notes, is very soon.
